(d u : List Bool) : TCSlib.Cryptography.LevinHardness.R_CKT d u ↔ ∃ (n : ℕ) (C : BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit n), C.IsFaninTwo ∧ C.encode = d ∧ C.eval (fun i => u.getD i false) = true
(q : PolyExpr) (x y : List Bool) : TCSlib.Cryptography.LevinHardness.certOf q x y = y ++ true :: List.replicate (q.eval x.length - y.length) false
(d : List Bool) (v : ℕ) : TCSlib.Cryptography.LevinHardness.retarget d v = TCSlib.Cryptography.LevinHardness.descPrefix d ++ BoolCircuit.encodeNat v

(s : List Bool) : TCSlib.Cryptography.LevinHardness.colorInst s = if TCSlib.Cryptography.LevinHardness.goodS s then TCSlib.Cryptography.encGraph (TCSlib.Cryptography.LevinHardness.gadgetGraph s.length (TCSlib.Cryptography.LevinHardness.memS s)) else TCSlib.Cryptography.encGraph TCSlib.Cryptography.LevinHardness.k4
(C : Std.Sat.CNF.Clause ℕ) : TCSlib.Cryptography.LevinHardness.clauseRec C = true :: Std.Sat.CNF.serializeClause C

(s a : List Bool) : TCSlib.Cryptography.LevinHardness.colorWord s a = TCSlib.Cryptography.encColoring (fun u : Fin (TCSlib.Cryptography.LevinHardness.gadgetN s.length) => TCSlib.Cryptography.LevinHardness.gadgetColor s.length (fun v => a.getD v false) u)
(K : ℕ) (mem : ℕ → Bool) : TCSlib.Cryptography.LevinHardness.gadgetFormula K mem = ((List.finRange ((2 * K) ^ 3)).filter fun c => mem c.val).map (TCSlib.Cryptography.LevinHardness.clauseEquiv K)
(w : List Bool) (B : ℕ) : TCSlib.Cryptography.LevinHardness.padColWord w B = w ++ List.replicate (2 * B - w.length) false
